title: Work Done by a Constant Force Vector
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A constant force F = 5i + 2j - k moves an object along a straight line from P(1, 0, 2) to Q(4, 3, 8). Find the total work done.

steps.title: Determine Displacement Vector
steps.explanation: Subtract initial point P from destination point Q.

steps.title: Calculate Work as F . D
steps.explanation: Compute the inner product of force and displacement.
